---
title: "Diagrams"
---

The diagrams below use the Mermaid syntax embedded in Quarto. They show simplified relationships among key classes in the project.

## data_contracts

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class DataModel
    DataModel <|-- RawAABBDetSeg
    DataModel <|-- AABBDetection
    DataModel <|-- AABBDetections
    DataModel <|-- RawOBBDetection
    DataModel <|-- OBBDetection
    DataModel <|-- OBBDetections
    DataModel <|-- PipelineIn
    DataModel <|-- DatasetOut
    AABBDetections "1" o-- "many" AABBDetection : contains
    OBBDetections "1" o-- "many" OBBDetection : contains
```

## live_agent

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class GeminiLiveAgent

    class AskCmd
    class AudioCmd
    class SetFrameCmd
    class TextEvt
    class AudioEvt
    class DetectionsEvt
    class ErrorEvt
    GeminiLiveAgent --> _ExecAPI : exposes

    GeminiLiveAgent ..> ErrorEvt
```
